name: docker-php-extension-installer
description_en: Easily install PHP extensions in Docker containers
readme_excerpt: Easy installation of PHP extensions in official PHP Docker images This repository contains a script that can be used to easily install a PHP extension inside the official PHP Docker images. The script will install all the required APT/APK packages; at the end of the script execution, the no-more needed packages will be removed so that the image will be much smaller.
